aboutGame.title: What is UPD Build a Car Collection?
paragraphs: UPD Build a Car Collection is a Roblox simulation and tycoon game from Fountain Entertainment where the goal is simple to state and hard to master: grow a garage full of rare and expensive cars. Each session you accept or decline incoming vehicles, earn cash, and decide whether to keep a car for your collection or flip it for a profit.

Progress is about more than buying the flashiest supercar first. You build income, unlock extra floors for more display space, chase Diamond Cars and exclusive event vehicles, and eventually take on Prestige to reset your garage for long-term rewards. Our wiki maps that whole loop with beginner steps, money routes, codes, and car tier rankings.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about UPD Build a Car Collection, from the gameplay loop and codes to cars, Prestige, and floors.

items.question: What is UPD Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: UPD Build a Car Collection is a Roblox simulation and tycoon game by Fountain Entertainment. You accept or decline cars, earn cash, expand your garage, unlock extra floors, and chase rare, expensive, and Diamond Cars.

items.question: How do I earn money fast in UPD Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Pick one high-payout activity and repeat it every session, then reinvest roughly half of your income into the next car while keeping a reserve for upgrades and repairs.

items.question: Are there codes in UPD Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Yes. UPD Build a Car Collection codes are usually released alongside game updates and can grant free cash, boosts, and exclusive vehicles. Redeem them in-game before they expire.

items.question: What are Diamond Cars in UPD Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Diamond Cars are premium collectibles that sit above standard vehicles in rarity and collection value. New ones arrive with major UPD Build a Car Collection content updates.

items.question: When should I Prestige in UPD Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Prestige in UPD Build a Car Collection is best attempted once your income loop is stable and repeatable, so the reset rewards feel like progress rather than a setback.

items.question: How do I unlock more floors in UPD Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Floors unlock as you grow your collection and hit in-game milestones. Extra floors give you more display space for the rare cars you collect in UPD Build a Car Collection.
